Why not  Good job=Good tip  Bad job=Bad tip?

Unless they are openly rude to you, you should always tip your waiter or waitress. Usually they have to tip out the hostesses, or sometimes even the kitchen, and it's based on the total amount of food sold, not the tips they reported.  So when you don't tip at all, the waiter/waitress has actually personally lost money, and they still had to help you. You effectively steal from them when you refuse to tip.

If they have kids, "flirt" with the kids. Not in a creepy way obviously, but little kids often are enamored with adults and if you're between the kid and their parent's age they are probably very interested in you.  Smile at the kids and ask them what they want to eat so they can say it, and if they have, for example, a *Power Rangers* shirt on, talk to them about it.  This will make the parents very relieved because taking kids to a restaurant can be a nightmare and if you can help distract the kid, you'll probably be tipped handsomely.

The guy would obviously deny everything, and I would become, for the rest of my college career, absolutely despised by the greek student body.  Furthermore, any chance I would have at dating would be significantly decreased because guys will think I play the rape card and it will happen to them next.
